reviewType: Independent read-only source, delta and retained-evidence review

resolvedFindings.finding: A thrown native execution could be reported as zero submissions without a returned outcome.
resolvedFindings.resolution: run-case01-native.mjs lines 615-625 set executionAttempted and fsync the append-only event history plus current summary before the sole native execute call. The shared observation helper returns null/UNKNOWN_AFTER_EXECUTION_INTENT for missing or invalid native counts after that intent. persist recomputes this observation for history and current summary, and final console output uses the same observation.
resolvedFindings.boundary: Actual returned integer counts 0 or 1 remain OBSERVED_NATIVE_OUTCOME. No bootstrap settlement, refund, reservation release or retry was added. The historical executionIntent flag is not proof of post-call settlement; a thrown call after native settlement or finalization requires actual owned journal/artifact readback.

resolvedFindings.finding: An older valid orchestrator ancestor could satisfy the original expected deployment while missing the qualified clock/provider guards.
resolvedFindings.resolution: buildCase01Scope line 65 calls the pure exact-deployment guard before setup receipt access. It compares the entire API/orchestrator source, digest, CodeBuild ID and buildspec hash object against the qualified pair. The operator invokes buildCase01Scope before adoption/reservation/authentication/conversation creation. Existing actual readCase01BuildAuthority and native admission checks remain unchanged and necessary.
resolvedFindings.boundary: The fixed expectation is not live release authority. The eventual scope still requires actual successful setup, reviewed receipt/hash, operator commit, manifest hash and served web source.
